ai-conversation-message-feedback.title: AI Conversation Message Feedback
ai-conversation-message-feedback.description: Represents feedback for a message within an AI conversation.

prompt_message_id.description:
Identifier of a conversation message that prompted 
the response message receiving the given feedback.

feedback.description: Text feedback from the user based on the message interaction.

account.description: A shorthand identifier for the associated account.

trigger_source.description: Identifier of the source that triggered the investigation.

linked_alert_id.description: The ID of the linked alert that triggered the investigation.

evidence_refs.description:
Information about the conditional evidence that 
was used to create the investigation
evidence_refs.example: It appears a service named XXXX has been returning many 400 errors

confidence_score.description:
A score between 0 and 1 indicating the 
confidence level of the investigation.

suggested_resolution.description:
Research finding and suggested resolution information for 
the investigation. This is a mixed-use field generally containing 
a serialized JSON string representing the structure: 
{ 
  summary: string, 
  timeline: [{ datetime: string, value: string }], 
  root_cause: string, 
  remediation_steps: string[], 
  linked_investigations: string[]
}
NOTE 1: String fields within this structure may or may not contain markdown.
NOTE 2: The timeline date is ISO 8601, e.g. 2024-06-19T12:00:00Z.
NOTE 3: The linked_investigations field contains investigation IDs.

resolution_status.description: The status of the investigation resolution.

created_at.description: The date and time when the investigation was created.

updated_at.description: The date and time when the investigation was last updated.
